verdict.rationale: Department-scoped permissions are a fair question for an FP&A/planning product, but nothing in the evidence documents role- or department-level access controls that limit a budget owner to their own numbers. The nearby items do not qualify: read-only board report links, per-tool agent allow/ask/deny policies, person-based sign-in, and per-client workspaces for advisors are adjacent controls, not scoped user permissions within a company model.
